name: knowledgex
description: Long-term memory with judgment for any AI agent, stored in the Open Knowledge Format (OKF).
author: rahulnyk

scripts.pack:mcpb: rm -rf build/mcpb && esbuild src/mcp.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=build/mcpb/server/mcp.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && cp -R manifest.json LICENSE guides build/mcpb/ && node node_modules/@anthropic-ai/mcpb/dist/cli/cli.js validate build/mcpb/manifest.json && node node_modules/@anthropic-ai/mcpb/dist/cli/cli.js pack build/mcpb KnowledgeX.mcpb
